questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设 } A_i \text{ 第一次取到 } i \text{ 号球，} i=1,2,3,\ B_i \text{ 第二次取到 } i \text{ 号球，} i=1,2,3,\ \text{则 } A_1,A_2,A_i \text{ 两两互相容，是一个完备事件组，且} \\ P(A_1)=\frac{2}{4},\quad P(A_2)=P(A_3)=\frac{1}{4},\\ P(B_1|A_1)=\frac{2}{4},\quad P(B_1|A_2)=\frac{2}{4},\quad P(B_1|A_3)=\frac{3}{6},\\ P(B_2|A_1)=\frac{1}{4},\quad P(B_2|A_2)=\frac{1}{4},\quad P(B_2|A_3)=\frac{2}{6},\\ P(B_3|A_1)=\frac{1}{4},\quad P(B_3|A_2)=\frac{1}{4},\quad P(B_3,A_3)=\frac{1}{6}.\\ \text{由全概率公式，有}\quad P(B_1)=\sum_{i=1}^3 P(A_i)P(B_1|A_i)=\frac{2}{4}\times \frac{2}{4}+\frac{1}{4}\times \frac{2}{4}+\frac{1}{4}\times \frac{3}{6}=\frac{1}{2},\\ \text{同理可得}\quad P(B_2)=\frac{13}{48},\quad P(B_3)=\frac{11}{48}.\\ \text{计算可知，第二次取得1号球的概率最大.} \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{设 } A_{1}=\{\text{抽到的是第一批产品}\},\ A_{2}=\{\text{抽到的是第二批产品}\},\ A_{3}=\{\text{抽到的是第三批产品}\},\\& \text{显然 } A_{1},A_{2},A_{3} \text{ 构成一个完备事件组，且 } P(A_{1})=P(A_{2})=P(A_{3})=\frac{1}{3},\\& \text{再设 } B=\{\text{取到优质品}\}, \text{则 } P(B|A_{1})=0.2,\ P(B|A_{2})=0.5,\ P(B|A_{3})=0.35,\\& \text{根据全概率公式有} \\& P(B)=P(A_{1})P(B|A_{1})+P(A_{2})P(B|A_{2})+P(A_{3})P(B|A_{3})=\frac{1}{3}(0.2+0.5+0.35)=0.35\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned} \text{人们为了解一只股票未来一定时期内价格的变化，往往会去分析影响股票价格的基本因素，比如利率的变化。现假设人们经分析估计利率下调的概率为60\%,利率不变的概率为40\%。根据经验，人们估计，在利率下调的情况下，该只股票价格上涨的概率为80\%，而在利率不变的情况下，其价格上涨的概率为40\%，则该只股票将上涨的概率为( )。} \end{aligned}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\text{记}A \text{为事件“利率下调”，那么} \overline{A} \text{即为“利率不变”，记} \overline{B} \text{为事件“股票价格上涨”。依题设知}\\P(A)=60\%, \qquad\quad P(\overline{A})=40\%,\\P(\overline{B}|\overline{A})=80\%, \qquad P(\overline{B}|\overline{A})=40\%, \\\text{于是} \quad P(\overline{B})=P(AB)+P(\overline{A}B)=P(A)P(\overline{B}|\overline{A})+P(\overline{A})P(\overline{B},\overline{A})\\=60\%\times 80\%+40\%\times 40\%=64\%.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} & \text{设 } A_1=\{ \text{从甲袋中取出两个球}\},\ A_2=\{ \text{从乙袋中取出两个球}\},\ A_3=\{ \text{从丙袋中取出两个球}\}, \text{显然} \\ & \quad P(A_1)=P(A_2)=P(A_3)=\frac{1}{3},\ \text{且 } A_1,A_2,A_3 \text{ 构成一个完备事件组。对于事件 } B=\{ \text{取到的两个球都是白球}\}, \text{有} \\ & \quad P(B|A_1)=\frac{C_2^2}{C_3^2}=\frac{1}{3},\ P(B|A_2)=\frac{C_2^2}{C_4^2}=\frac{1}{6},\ P(B|A_3)=\frac{C_2^2}{C_9^2}=\frac{1}{6}, \\ & \text{根据全概率公式知} \\ & \quad P(B)=P(A_1)P(B|A_1)+P(A_2)P(B|A_2)+P(A_3)P(B|A_3) \\ & \quad=\frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{6}+\frac{1}{6}\right)=\frac{2}{9}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设事件} A: “\text{第二次取到红球}”，\text{事件} B: “\text{第一次取到红球}”， \\ \text {则} P(B) = \frac{3}{5},\ P(\overline{B}) = \frac{2}{5},\ P(A|B) = \frac{2}{4},\ P(A|\overline{B}) = \frac{3}{4}, \\ \text {所以由全概率公式得} \\ P(A) = P(B)P(A|B) + P(\overline{B})P(A|\overline{B}) = \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{2}{4} + \frac{2}{5} \times \frac{3}{4} = \frac{12}{20} = \frac{3}{5}. \end{array}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设事件}A: \text{“第二次取到正品”}, \text{事件}B: \text{“第一次取到正品”}, \text{则} \\ P(B) = \frac{100-10}{100} = 0.9,\ P(\overline{B}) = \frac{10}{100} = 0.1, \\ P(A|B) = \frac{100-10-1}{100-1} = \frac{89}{99},\ P(\overline{A}|\overline{B}) = \frac{100-10}{100-1} = \frac{90}{99}, \\ \text{所以由全概率公式得} \\ P(A) = P(B)P(A|\overline{B}) + P(\overline{B})P(A\overline{B}) = 0.9 \times \frac{89}{99} + 0.1 \times \frac{90}{99} = 0.9\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}A_i(i=1,2,3) \text{分别表示所取一箱产品是甲，乙，丙厂生产的事件；} B:\text{“取得一件产品为正品”}.\\P(A_1)=\frac{3}{6},\quad P(B|A_1)=\frac{9}{10},\\P(A_2)=\frac{2}{6},\quad P(B|A_2)=\frac{14}{15},\\P(A_3)=\frac{1}{6},\quad P(B|A_3)=\frac{19}{20}.\\\text{由全概率公式}\quad P(B)=\sum_{i=1}^3 P(A_i)P(B|A_i)=\frac{3}{6}\times \frac{9}{10}+\frac{2}{6}\times \frac{14}{15}+\frac{1}{6}\times \frac{19}{20}\\=\frac{162+112+57}{360}=\frac{331}{360}(\approx 0.92).\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}A_{i}(i=1,2):&\text{“放入乙盒的螺钉中有}i\text{只正品}”，B:“\text{乙盒中取出的二只螺钉是一只次品}，\text{一只正品}”.\\P(A_{1})&=\frac{C_{1}^{1}C_{0}^{1}}{C_{10}^{2}}=\frac{1}{5},\quad P(B|A_{1})=\frac{C_{2}^{1}C_{10}^{1}}{C_{12}^{2}}=\frac{10}{33}.\\P(A_{1})&=\frac{C_{9}^{2}}{C_{10}^{2}}=\frac{4}{5},\quad P(B|A_{2})=\frac{C_{1}^{1}C_{11}^{1}}{C_{12}^{2}}=\frac{1}{6}.\end{aligned}
